newsitem.title: ISRAEL: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon raises Nice EPS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Salomon raises Nice EPS.

text.p: Salomon Brothers maintained its strong buy recommendation for Nice Systems Ltd and upgraded its 1997 earnings estimate after the Israeli company reported better-than-expected first quarter results.

Nice earned $0.28 a share in the first quarter against Salomon's $0.25 estimate and Wall Street consensus estimates of $0.26. Salomon upgraded its earnings per share (EPS) estimate for all of 1997 to $1.27 from $1.25.

Salomon analyst Victor Halpert said revenues for Nice, which produces computer telephony integration products and Comint systems, increased by 64 percent to $13.4 million, 4.6 percent above Salomon's $12.75 million forecast.
Comint systems are used by military and government intelligence agencies to monitor and record transmissions from a variety of sources.

"Nice is benefiting from manufacturing efficiencies as well as the benefits of higher volumes and improved profitability on logging systems with a large number of subscribers," Halpert said in a report.
Halpert said gross profit margin continued to improve, growing to 57.05 percent from 52.4 percent a year earlier.
"Our 12-month target price range remains $30-$33 per share...We believe that Nice's stock should trade at the premium to the average of its peers," the report said.
Nice shares on Nasdaq are trading at $26-7/8.
